about: Frozen demo question set. Written and verified against the corpus BEFORE any retrieval change, so improvements cannot be tuned toward it. A question counts as retrieved when every one of its probes appears in the top-k chunks. Probes are matched with all whitespace removed, so the corpus's extraction artifacts ('rup ees', 'Informati on') do not cause false misses. Use 'dev' while iterating. Check 'heldout' only at the end -- it is casual phrasing, deliberately unlike anything in the corpus. 'heldout2' was written after 'heldout' had been looked at once, and before query rewriting was built -- it is the clean final test for the query-rewrite step. 'heldout3' was written after all earlier sets had been used, and before testing section titles in Act embeddings and the answer-prompt changes of 2026-09-13; it is the clean test for those. 'heldout4' (13, casual) was written on 2026-10-04 before the router and the reranking / fusion experiments of that day; it is the clean test for them. 'final' (15) was written on 2026-10-04 after the baseline run and BEFORE any of that day's retrieval experiments, in deliberately mixed styles (Telugu-English, typos, long stories, two-word queries). It is run only twice: baseline and the chosen configuration.
